phase_a_orientation.summary: OrderService.createOrder(Order) is annotated @Transactional, calls OrderRepository.save(order), then immediately invokes EventPublisher.publish with the string "ORDER_CREATED:" + order.getId(). EventPublisher and OrderRepository are simple interfaces, and the local @Transactional type is only a runtime annotation. There is currently no outbox/persisted event or explicit after-commit coordination, so event emission is a direct synchronous-looking call following the save in the same workflow.
